Tom Aldridge 3:12 AM
Thanks. Ping me if it turns into a page.
Priya Raman 3:14 AM
Root cause is the connection pool on the read
replica. We raised max connections last week
for the migration and never put it back, so the
gateway was opening more sockets than the
replica would accept and failing closed instead
of queueing. Rolled the config back at 3:41 and
error rate was under one percent within four
minutes. Nothing was lost, but roughly nine
thousand requests got a 502 during the window.
You 7:40 AM

open?

customer impact section before the review at 4?
